title: The Tower
synopsis: In a barren, resource-depleted world, a solitary tower stands alone across the wasteland. Inside, an old man and a young boy live a quiet, ritualistic life, sustained by a single well and the daily act of nurturing the last traces of green in a dying world — until a wounded stranger stumbles into their world.

audienceReactions.quote: No need for words. The story was so thought provoking. Survival through being resourceful, kind and knowing an unknown universal truth. Just beautiful!
audienceReactions.author: YouTube viewer

audienceReactions.quote: This was a great short, the detail of the boy's day gets me on the beast part and I enjoyed it.
